g.title: HR_JOB
g.text: Job - Contains a collection of information relating to a job. A job can be thought of as a template for a position. A position is an instance of a job. Jobs describe the nature of the work, whereas related positions represent the time, place, and organizational structure in which a person or persons actually perform the work. Positions usually have a specific budget associated with them.
Is the Job Name a person can be given within the organization. Examples are Director, Software Engineer, Purchasing Manager etc
